Acceptance criteria: Executor cannot select from documents or update policies (role test); pausing kill switch stops next pick-up within 10 s; crash mid-submit does not double-submit (idempotency).

Summary: Connector: Zerodha Kite Connect (equity orders + MF read)
Description: Kite Connect adapter: daily request_token exchange via user login + TOTP; place/modify/cancel equity/ETF/REIT/SGB orders; positions; MF read endpoints (holdings, orders, SIPs) as a reconciliation source. No MF order placement exists on Kite. No vendor sandbox: use a dedicated low-balance test account with the SANDBOX flag enforcing quantity=1 limits.
Acceptance criteria: Test-account equity order round-trips; MF holdings read matches CAS; expired session flags connector and blocks queueing with a task for the user to log in.

Summary: Connector: ICICI Direct Breeze, Upstox, Angel SmartAPI, Dhan
Description: Same adapter interface; per-provider auth quirks; capability matrix (which kinds each supports).
Acceptance criteria: Capability matrix served by /actions/schemas; each adapter passes the shared contract test suite in sandbox.

Summary: Connector: BSE StAR MF via RIA/ARN code (Cybrilla FP or SOAP) with NACH mandates
Description: Investor onboarding on the family's BSE code (UCC, FATCA, bank), NACH e-mandate registration and status, purchase/redemption/switch/SIP with mandate-based payment, order status polling, allotment → CAS reconciliation; Cybrilla Fintech Primitives adapter first, raw BSE SOAP as fallback; MF kinds flip from assisted to executable per investor once mandate is active.
Acceptance criteria: Test-market purchase against a registered mandate allots units and reconciles from CAS; intent for an investor without an active mandate is created as assisted with a task to register one.

Summary: Connectors: ICICI Corporate API Suite (HUF current account), BBPS agent, assisted UPI intent
Description: ICICI CIB APIs: beneficiary registration (payee allow-list sync), NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI initiation with portal-authorisation mode configurable, transaction status/UTR polling, balance; BBPS agent (Setu) fetch-bill/pay/receipt for property tax, utilities, premiums; assisted UPI-intent generator for savings accounts. HDFC/Axis/Yes/Kotak adapters behind the same interface (P2).
Acceptance criteria: UAT NEFT returns UTR and reconciles to the AA feed; unregistered beneficiary is rejected before submission; BBPS property-tax bill fetched by assessment number and paid; UPI link opens the correct payee/amount.

Description: Anthropic API with tool use; read tools over the family API; propose_intent as the only write; system prompt with policies + current simulation; structured outputs; session/message storage with model version; rate limits; PII minimisation; refusal rules.
Acceptance criteria: Prototype 'deploy cash' transcript reproduces (4 drafts); assistant cannot call approve/queue (tool absent + server-side 403); every tool call logged.

Description: POST /actions/from-source for tasks, plan actions, deployment plans, rent reminders, committed outflows, IPS breaches, rebalance proposals; auto-approve for operator-scoped low-risk kinds (rent_reminder) per policy.
Acceptance criteria: Approving a plan creates intents in one batch; rent reminder auto-approves and sends; nothing that moves money auto-approves.

Description: actions.reconcile after imports: match fills/UTRs to investment_txns/bank_txns; variance; mark task/plan action verified; GL posting via existing rules with intent link.
Acceptance criteria: A-112 style flow: fill → CAS import → reconciled → journal posted with intent id in narration.

Description: GET /oversight; anomaly signals (new payee, 3× median, off-hours, rapid approve, new IP, repeated failures); limits usage; policy change log; execution audit / approval log / connector activity reports.
Acceptance criteria: Prototype oversight tab reproduces on seed; anomaly on new-payee fires for A-116.

Description: Six web tabs per prototype; mobile approvals inbox with biometric step-up, kill switch, assistant chat; push deep links.
Acceptance criteria: Owner approves a batch from phone with Face ID in < 20 s; kill switch reachable in 2 taps.

Description: Threat model of the action plane; pen test on executor/vault/approval; SEBI API-trading compliance note (manual orders, static IP, order-rate cap); RBI/payment partner agreements; per-connector dry-run sign-off; kill-switch drill.
Acceptance criteria: Findings closed; family goes live one connector at a time with SANDBOX_ONLY flipped per connector.

Description: Per-investor e-mandate flow (net-banking/debit-card auth) in favour of BSE StAR MF; mandate limits aligned to policy caps; status, expiry and utilisation tracked; tasks when a purchase would exceed the mandate.
Acceptance criteria: Mandate registered in test market; purchase above limit is split or flagged; expiring mandate raises a task 30 days ahead.

Description: investment_policies/policy_versions/policy_allocations/policy_risk_limits per migration 009; one active version; inheritance resolver (family → entity → goal) returning effective clauses with origin; clause-level diff; validation (lens sums to 100, min ≤ target ≤ max).
Acceptance criteria: Effective policy for the seeded retirement goal shows 6 overrides and inherited clauses; two active versions on one policy is impossible (DB); diff lists changed clauses only.

Description: System questionnaire seeded by 009; family-defined questionnaires; scoring with capacity-caps-tolerance and horizon adjustment; profile → suggested model portfolio and limit set.
Acceptance criteria: Seeded answers reproduce the prototype scores (44 → moderately conservative); a high-tolerance/low-capacity response profiles to the capacity band.

Description: 10-step builder; pre-fill from profile/model/parent; simulate step (compliance if activated, tax-aware moves, expected return/vol vs objective); approve/sign with step-up; activation writes bucket_targets, asset_class_targets, ips_rules, execution_policies, glide_paths with policy_version_id and supersedes the prior version.
Acceptance criteria: Activating a version updates the live tables atomically; editing a target elsewhere is redirected to 'amend policy'; signatures recorded with auth evidence.

Description: Nightly risk.metrics from valuations_daily and prices: volatility, max drawdown, VaR 95 (historical), beta, tracking error, Sharpe, top-5 concentration, issuer/manager/sector max, illiquid %, liquidity coverage months, unrated %, leverage, FX exposure, duration; per scope; history.
Acceptance criteria: Fixtures match reference calculations to 2 dp; runs < 2 min for 500 holdings; metrics available to compliance and reports.

Description: policy.compliance per active version: allocation bands (look-through), risk limits with warn/limit, permitted list, IPS rules, liquidity, glide path; overall status; tasks on breach; rebalancing intents when policy allows; assistant and action-plane policy check consult the effective policy.
Acceptance criteria: Prototype compliance snapshot reproduces on seed; a prohibited instrument intent fails with the clause cited; breach task closes when the next snapshot is clean.

Description: policy.reviews daily: schedule by cadence (task 30 days ahead), triggers (breach > 30 d, drawdown beyond clause, goal change, new entity, regulation flag); findings pre-fill; outcome handling (reset date / link amended draft / supersede).
Acceptance criteria: Seeded goal breach opens a trigger review after 30 days; completing with 'amended' links the new draft and the diff.

Summary: IPS document, compliance and review-pack reports
Description: Render the Investment Policy Statement PDF (clauses, tables, limits, guardrails, signatures, change log); policy compliance report with metric history; review pack; scheduled delivery to principal/CA per monitoring clause.
Acceptance criteria: Prototype document text reproduces for the retirement goal; PDF regenerates on each version; review pack attaches to the review.

Description: Seven web tabs per prototype; mobile: read policies and compliance, complete questionnaire, sign/approve with biometric.
Acceptance criteria: Owner completes questionnaire and signs a version from phone; web builder round-trips a full policy in < 15 min for an operator.

Description: research_sources/channels/items per migration 010; second inbound email address per family with sender allow-list → source; upload/paste; RSS/web watch poller; WhatsApp Business inbox (BSP) P1; content-hash de-dup; text extraction via extraction service; unattributed-sender triage.
Acceptance criteria: Same PDF forwarded twice is ingested once; email from an allow-listed sender is attributed to its source; unknown sender lands in triage.

Description: Research agent extracts zero-or-more structured recommendations per item with instrument resolution against the master, action, thesis, target/stop, horizon, conviction, publish date/price, confidence; low-confidence → review queue; corrections feed back.
Acceptance criteria: Sample broker note yields 6 recommendations with ≥ 0.85 confidence; unresolved instrument kept as text and flagged; correction persists.

Description: Cluster by instrument × direction within a rolling window across sources; trust-weighted conviction; consensus line; supersession when a source flips.
Acceptance criteria: Three bullish L&T calls form one cluster with '3 of 3'; a later sell from one source updates consensus and conviction.

Description: Assess a cluster against the effective Investment Policy for an entity/goal (permitted, bands after, issuer/sector/manager caps, rating, liquidity, tax preferences), portfolio overlap via look-through, already-held weight; verdict + fit score + sizing headroom; prohibited/conflicting auto-dismissed with clause; sell/avoid on held positions always surfaced.
Acceptance criteria: Prototype verdicts reproduce on seed (fits / fits with conditions / prohibited / conflicts); sizing equals min(issuer headroom, band headroom, cash).

Description: draft_proposal tool: memo sections (summary, thesis, sources with track record and conflicts, counter-view mandatory, policy fit by clause, portfolio impact, tax/cash via planner, risks, sizing, execution plan by entity/connector, exit plan, monitoring triggers); citations to tool results; versioning; PDF render; expiry.
Acceptance criteria: Proposal for the L&T cluster contains all sections with cited numbers; a proposal without a counter-view fails validation; PDF renders.

Description: approve/reject/defer with role checks and notes; batch decide on a digest with one step-up; approve+convert creates an action-plane intent batch (subject to its own checks); deferred re-surfaces; rejected feeds track record; proposal state machine (DB) tested.
Acceptance criteria: Approving with a reduced amount creates two intents in pending_approval; illegal transitions rejected; deferred proposal reappears in the next digest.

Description: research.digest weekly (configurable): items, recommendations, clusters, declined-with-reasons, themes (agent summary), source leaderboard movement, proposals awaiting decision; PDF + in-app + push; monthly copy to CA.
Acceptance criteria: Sunday digest reproduces the prototype for the seeded week; every dismissed cluster appears with its reason.

Summary: Source track record and trust scores
Description: research.track_record nightly: evaluate each recommendation at 3/6/12/24 months vs price and benchmark; hit rate, excess return, sample size per source and horizon; trust score update rule; conflict-of-interest display; leaderboard endpoint and report.
Acceptance criteria: Backfilled fixture of 40 recommendations yields hit rates within 1 pp of the reference sheet; trust scores move within bounds.

Description: Five web tabs per prototype; mobile: digest with approve/reject/defer and biometric step-up, share-sheet ingestion (forward a PDF/screenshot into the inbox), proposal reader.
Acceptance criteria: Owner decides a digest from phone in < 2 min; sharing a screenshot from WhatsApp creates an inbox item.

Description: rebalance_programs per scope from the policy rebalancing clause; trigger evaluator: calendar (RRULE), band breach, drift threshold, milestones (years-to-go, funded %, glide step, life event, net-worth crossing, age), funding need in look-ahead, large flow, tax year-end, policy change, manual; rebalance.evaluate nightly + event hooks.
Acceptance criteria: Each trigger has a unit test; the MBA goal fires at 3 years to go; a large inflow of 6% triggers a run; runs record 'no action' when nothing is needed.

Description: rebalance.needs nightly: goal drawdown schedules, fund commitment schedules, advance tax/GST from planner, liability schedule, premiums, planned expenses from forecast, buffer rebuilds; manual needs; priority/flexibility; need_coverage from cash, maturities, distributions and planned moves; status transitions as cash arrives.
Acceptance criteria: Seeded needs reproduce the prototype list; Varaha call shows partial coverage from cash and the rest from move #2; a met need flips status on bank reconciliation.

Description: lots.constraints nightly: lock-in (ELSS, SGB, PPF, FD, AIF), exit-load windows from scheme master/fact sheets, LTCG eligibility from tax_rules, settlement days and liquidity class by instrument type; manual override; GET /holdings/:id/lot-constraints.
Acceptance criteria: BAF lot bought 02 Nov 2025 shows exit load until 02 Oct 2026 and LTCG on 02 Nov 2026; ELSS lot locked 3 years.

Summary: Solver: sources, uses, lot selection, timing
Description: packages/finance/rebalance: snapshot → objective → sources in order (idle cash, maturities, redirected contributions, tax-aware sales with lot selection skipping lock-ins, deferring exit-load and near-LTCG lots) → uses (needs by priority/date, under-weights, glide) → timing (earliest/latest/planned per move, settlement buffer, dependencies, FY split, hold-cash) → plan with summary and warnings; deterministic; constraints from program.
Acceptance criteria: Prototype plan reproduces on seed (move #2 chooses the LTCG-eligible lot and dates 7 Oct; T-bill replaced by liquid fund because maturity is after the need); property tests: no move under lock-in, no hard need left uncovered without a warning, turnover ≤ cap.

Description: Plan versions with edit (exclude/adjust → re-solve); simulate via planner + policy compliance; review/approve with step-up; convert to action-plane intents scheduled on planned_date (executor holds until date; assisted where no connector); reconciliation back to moves and needs; FSM tested.
Acceptance criteria: Approving creates dated intents; an intent released only on its planned date; fill marks the move executed and updates need coverage.

Description: GET /rebalance/calendar merging moves, settlements, needs, calendar runs, milestones, LTCG/exit-load/lock-in dates; run history; reports rebalance_plan, funding_calendar, rebalance_history.
Acceptance criteria: Prototype calendar reproduces; PDF plan lists moves with constraint checks.

Description: Five web tabs per prototype with solver trace per move; mobile: needs, plan review/approve with biometric, calendar.
Acceptance criteria: Owner approves a plan from phone; operator edits a move date and gets v2 with re-solved timing.
